author: David Robillard and Jalv contributors
modifications: C++ adaptation of request/response lifecycle. Zix rings, semaphores and threads replaced by fixed complete-packet SPSC queues, std::counting_semaphore and std::thread. Atomic shutdown drains accepted work and responses before plugin cleanup; offline replies arrive before schedule returns; zero-length packets supported; queue sizes and render response delivery bounded. Original Worker copyright added alongside the upstream ISC license notice. Added reversible quiesce/resume: exclude rendering, drain/join Worker requests, deliver replies and synchronous follow-up work, then resume background processing after state operations.
